translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: ID POKITA
book.title: DOS ID POKITA ni Disas Krays ki Juan

content: Dos Lammin Langit woy Lammin Livuta
Na, nokita ku iddos lammin langit woy lammin livuta, su iddos tapoy'n langit woy tapoy'n livuta, ahad iddos dahat, nongowora ron.

Nokita ku mandad iddos uhis no bonuwa no idda en so Lammin Jerusalem no id poonna to Monama pomon diyot datas to langit. Inin bonuwa, nopanoy ron, iling to ba-ay nod kosalon no noko-oumpak to umpak atag to kosaa woy id pogondan amoy'd tommu taddot od osawa kandin.

Na, norinog ku no duwon monokkaan bawos pomon diyot trunu no mid ungketen to, “Ko-ungkay iddos ubpan to Monama, diyon don to mgo minuvu rin, woy od ubpa sikandin duma kandan. Od kilaannon din sikandan no mgo sakup din, woy od kilaannon dan mandad sikandin no Monama ran.
Od punason to Monama kos mgo dayas dan, woy worad kopotayan, kodlanu, kodsinoggow, ahad iddos mgo bohok, oyya su iddos langun no riyot tapoy'n ingod, nongowora ron.”
Na iddos id unsad diyot trunu, mid ikahi koddi to, “Ko-ungkay id lammi kud kos langun.” Woy kahi rin mandon to, “Sulat du inin mgo osengan, oyyos od kosolihan ini woy bonnaa en.”

Ponayun sikandin mid ikahi to, “Notuman don kos langun! Siyak kos Alpa woy Omega, no iddos kohulugan, dos tigkonayan woy dos kotompusan. Iddos minuvu no notokkangan, od po-inommon ku to oweg no waa bayad pomon diyot sobsob no od pokovoggoy to umuun waad tomanon.
Na iddos od pokoponalu to kopomakoy rin koddi, od pokotanggap to langun tadda pomon koddi. Siyak kos Monama ran, woy sikandan kos mgo anak ku.

Piru iddos taawon, dos konnod pompomakoy, dos morat kos pinuungan, dos mongimatoy, dos od laayuk to konna ran sawa, dos od loommoy, dos od ponsimba to konna bonnaan monama woy dos langun no bouhuson, iyon dan od ingumannon, iddos linow't apuy no idda en so od loglog no asupre. Na, idda en kos iko-oruwon kopotayan.”
Dos Lammin Jerusalem

Na, id porani koddi iddos sokkad taddot pittun ponolihan no id pompiyod taddot pittun yohung no noponnu mandad to pittun kotompusan no kororattan. Mid ikahi sikandin koddi to, “Duma ka koddi, su id pokita ku kikow iddos od osowan to Natin Karnero.”

Na, no-iroomman a to Ispiritu to Monama, woy id piyod a taddot ponolihan diyot oray'n mowwet no buvungan. Id pokita rin koddi iddos uhis no bonuwa, no idda en so Jerusalem no id poonna to Monama pomon diyot datas to langit.
Noso-ob idda to se-aa to kotuusan to Monama, woy od sella idda iling to mahaa no batu no haspe no moti-aw iling to oungan.

Iddon bonuwa, nolingkus to motikang no aavat no duwon sopuu-oruwon sobbangan. Woy riyon to ipat sobbangan tadda, duwon ponolihan no id tamong, woy nokosulat dutun iddos ipat sokkad no ngaran taddot sopuu-oruwon anak ni Israel.
Otollun sobbangan kos diyon lomig tid tollak, otollu kos diyon lomig tid saop, otollu kos diyon lomig to boovahan to kowanan woy otollu mandad kos diyon lomig to boovahan to ivang.
Dos motikang no aavat, id po-unsad diyot sopuu-oruwa no doorakkoon batu. Woy riyon to ipat batu, nokosulat iddos ipat sokkad no ngaran taddot sopuu-oruwon apostoles to Natin Karnero.
Na iddos ponolihan nid oseng koddi, id piyod to buawan no toppong no iling to tukod, su amoy od topongngon din iddos bonuwa, dos mgo sobbangan woy dos mgo aavat tadda.

Oppat no sungguk iddon bonuwa no nokod-iling da en kos koowettoy woy koowaggoy. To id toppong idda to ponolihan, oruwon maan woy oppat no gatus (2,400) no kilometro kos koowettoy. Ungketen dad en mandad kos koowaggoy woy kotikangoy.
To id toppong mandad taddot ponolihan iddos kotikangoy to aavat, annom-no-puun metro idda. (Dos topongngan no id gamit din, iling dad en taddot od gomiton to mgo minuvu).
Iddon bonuwa, paanan buawan woy moti-aw iling to oungan, woy dos aavat tadda, oray'n mahaa no batu nod ngoranan no haspe.
Dos mgo batu no po-unsaran taddot motikang no aavat, id tawwan to nokod-osso-osson mahaa woy motoos no mgo batu.

content.text: Iddos unnon po-unsaran, batu no haspe,
dos iko-sopuu oruwa, batu no amatista.

content: Dos sopuu-oruwon sobbangan, paanan perlas, su iddos ipat sobbangan, sokkad no dakkoon perlas. Paanan buawan kos koosada taddon bonuwa woy oray'n moti-aw iling to oungan.
Waa nokita ku no templo taddon bonuwa. Konnad ko-ilangan iddos templo rutun, oyya su riyon en iddos Monama no Motuus to Langun woy dos Natin Karnero.
Konnad mandad ko-ilangan dutun iddos taddow to allow woy buwan. Oyya su iddos id pomonnan to se-aa rutun, idda en so se-aa to kotuusan to Monama, woy dos suu, idda en so Natin Karnero.
Dos langun no minuvu ka-ay to ampow't ingod, od kotorawwan tat se-aa taddon bonuwa. Woy dos mgo hari to intirut ingod, od piyod to mgo korotuwan dan dutun.
Inaayun od lukatan iddos mgo sobbangan taddon bonuwa, woy dii ron en idda od lokobban, oyyos worad man bulli.
Woy dos langun to minuvu ka-ay to ampow't ingod, od piyod mandad to kandan no korotuwan dutun.

Piru diid poko-usok iddos ahad ondoy no konna molinis diyot isowwan to Monama, dos molibmit kos pinuungan woy dos mgo bouhuson. Iyon da od poko-usok dutun, iddos mgo minuvu no nokosulat kos ngaran diyot libru to umuu taddot Natin Karnero. Na, idda en kos id sulatan to ngaran taddot langun nod boggayan to umuun waad tomanon.
